label: ✨ LLM classify
description: Use the configured LLM to assign each row's text to one of N labels. Zero-shot — no fine-tuning needed. Adds a `<output_column>` plus `<output_column>_confidence` (high/medium/low). Each row = one LLM call, so use sample_rows upstream when prototyping.

context.label: Task context
context.default: Classify the text into one of the labels.
context.help: Optional: a sentence telling the LLM what the labels mean.
